notes.title: Translations update
notes.notes:
-Improved quality of all translation
-Added a new language "Basque" for our Spaniard friends

-Mejorada la calidad de las traducciones
-Se ha añadido el Euskera a las traducciones del juego

notes.title: Fix for windows version
notes.notes:
Hi there folks!!,

By mistake the uploaded of the linux version had the windows one corrupted. We've uploaded a new windows version. Apologies for our mistake :)
Have fun!

notes.title: Linux version added
notes.notes:
Hi there!,

To allow more awesomeness we've added a linux version as well. So now everyone can play Delta Squad and enjoy the awesome local coop with some friends!

notes.title: Hotfix - End game
notes.notes:
Hi there!!,

We've uploaded a new version fixing a couple of bugs, and a crash at the end of the game.

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Support for keyboard and mouse
notes.notes:
Hi,

Here we are with a new update, we've finally added support for keyboard and mouse for 1 player.
So, 1 of the 4 players will be able to play with keyboard and mouse :)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've fixed some issues regarding to controllers not detected properly after the game was launched... Those pesky bugs...

Enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Hotfix and translation fixes
notes.notes:
Hey hey!!,

We've updated the game to fix a couple of bugs making some missions to crash. Also we've fixed some minor translations issues.

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Update with more languages
notes.notes:
Hi!,

We've added more languages to the game:
-Russian
-French
-Italian
-German

Enjoy the game!!!!

notes.title: Update with Portuguese-Brazilian!
notes.notes:
Hi,

We've added Portuguese-Brazilian to the game and the store as well. Now you can enjoy the game in more languages :)

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Hotfix available. A pesky bug doesn't allow you to restart a level, but fear not, you will continue fighting in no time!!

notes.title: Update with more languages incoming!!
notes.notes:
We are working in an update to add more languages to the game and the steam page as well.
The new languages added will be:

Russian
Italian
French
German
Portuguese-Brazilian

notes.title: Released!
notes.notes: Welcome to Delta Squad!, prepare yourself or gather some friends to enjoy this old school arcade. Remember the arcade cabinets from the 90'?, well, then Delta Squad might be the game you're looking for!
